answer: Asynchronous Temporal Decryption Quorum. Every registered agent must periodically solve a unique cryptographic puzzle called a cipher within a strict verification window. The system routes each puzzle fragment across a distributed memory lagoon to prevent parallel processing by a single controller. An attacker attempting to maintain thousands of sybil identities incurs massive computational delays and processing overhead.
